rules.title: How It Works
rules.subtitle: Everything you need to know to play Trixer.
rules.s1p1: Trixer is an athlete market game based on real triathlon races (Full and Middle Distance). You start with a T$100 wallet, buy athletes on the market, and watch your roster's value rise or fall based on race results.
rules.s1p2: Your team for any race is your current roster. You can own exactly 5 athletes. The goal is to buy at the right time, sell before an athlete's value drops, and build the best possible roster.
rules.s1example: You buy Kristian Blummenfelt for T$35. He wins IRONMAN Texas. His value rises to T$40. If you sell now, you pocket T$40 — a T$5 profit. Or hold for the next race.
rules.s2p1: Every account starts with T$100 in Trix Coins (T$). That's your budget to buy athletes on the market.
rules.s2li1: Buy: the athlete's price is debited from your wallet and they join your roster.
rules.s2li2: Sell: the athlete's current price is credited to your wallet and they leave your roster.
rules.s2li3: Roster limit: you must have exactly 5 athletes to score fully.
rules.s2example: Wallet: T$100. You buy 3 athletes: T$35 + T$28 + T$22 = T$85 spent. Wallet drops to T$15. Roster worth T$85. Total net worth stays T$100 — no gain yet.
rules.s3p1: In the market you see all athletes with their current price and movement. Base prices are set based on the athlete's level:
rules.s3p2: After each race, prices are updated:
rules.s3price3: Position: movement based on actual result
rules.s3example: Marta Sánchez was worth T$18. She finished 3rd at IRONMAN Texas → price rose to T$21. If you bought before the race and sold after, you made T$3 profit per athlete.
rules.s4Title: Market Window — When Can I Buy and Sell?
rules.s4p1: The market closes 24 hours before any race. It reopens only when the results of that race are published.
rules.s4openDesc: More than 24h until the next race. Buy and sell freely.
rules.s4lockedDesc: Less than 24h to the race or race in progress. No transactions.
rules.s4warning: ⚠ Note: athletes who DNS (do not start) have their price reduced. Follow pre-race news — if your athlete withdrew, you have up to 24h before the race to sell.
rules.s4example: IRONMAN South Africa is on Saturday. The market closes Friday at midnight UTC. After results are published, the market reopens and you can rebalance your roster for the next race.
rules.s5p1: You don't need to "pick" a team for each race. Your team is always your current roster of 5 athletes.
rules.s5li1: If an athlete in your roster is in the race, they will score.
rules.s5li2: If the athlete is not in the race, they score 0 points.
rules.s5li3: You can swap roster athletes whenever the market is open.
rules.s5example: Your roster has 5 athletes. 3 of them are in IRONMAN Texas. On race day, those 3 score for you. If you want to swap the other 2, you must do it before the market closes.
rules.s6p1: Scoring is calculated by position in the PRO field:
rules.s6bonus: +6 pts for the fastest segment (swim, bike or run) among all PROs.
rules.s7p1: Compete with friends on who has the best accumulated roster or in specific races.
rules.s7li1: Ranked by Trix Score — the sum of points from the athletes in your roster in the race.
rules.s8li1: Buy before races: athletes who perform well rise in price. Buy early, sell after.
rules.s8li2: Watch for DNS: if a favourite withdrew, sell before the market closes.
rules.s8li3: Net worth = wallet + roster: track P&L for each athlete in My Roster.
rules.s9li1: Trixer is a recreational game — no cash prizes.
rules.s9li2: We are not affiliated with Ironman/WTC or any triathlon organisation.
rules.s9li3: Results are entered manually — there may be a delay after the race.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1p1: Trixer is a fantasy sports platform focused on the professional triathlon circuit (IRONMAN and 70.3). This document describes how we collect, use, and protect user information.
privacy.s2p1: When you register and use Trixer, we collect:
privacy.s2li2: In-game actions: athlete purchases, sales, and roster selections
privacy.s2li4: Session data and access logs (for security and diagnostics)
privacy.s2p2: We do not collect payment data. Trixer is free.
privacy.s3li1: Operate the game: display your roster, team, scores, and rankings
privacy.s3li3: Generate aggregated and anonymous usage statistics
privacy.s3li4: Prevent fraud and ensure game integrity
privacy.s3p1: We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties for commercial purposes.
privacy.s4p1: Data is stored on the Supabase platform, hosted on secure infrastructure with encryption in transit (TLS) and at rest. Access is restricted by Row Level Security (RLS) — each user only accesses their own data.
privacy.s5p1: Information about professional athletes (name, nationality, PTO ranking, race results) is publicly available and obtained from open sources such as the PTO (Professional Triathletes Organisation) and official IRONMAN results. We do not store sensitive personal data of athletes.
privacy.s6li1: Request deletion of your account and all associated data
privacy.s6li2: Request a copy of the data we hold about you
privacy.s6li3: Correct incorrect information in your profile
privacy.s6p2: To exercise these rights, contact us by email:
privacy.s7p1: We use strictly necessary cookies for authentication and session management. We do not use advertising tracking cookies or third-party analytics tools.
privacy.s8p1: Trixer is not directed at children under 13. If we become aware that we have collected data from minors without parental consent, we will remove that information immediately.
privacy.s9p1: We may update this policy periodically. Significant changes will be communicated by email or in-app notification. Continued use of the platform after changes implies acceptance of the new policy.

tour.step0Content: The ultimate fantasy game for triathlon fans. Let us show you how to start your journey to the top of the rankings.
tour.step1Content: You start with T$100. Use this balance to buy your first PRO athletes on the market. The goal is to grow your portfolio.
tour.step2Content: You must have exactly 5 athletes. Your current roster is your official team for all races on the calendar.
tour.step3Content: When the market is open, you can buy and sell athletes whenever you want. Prices rise and fall based on real race results — keep an eye out and trade at the right time!
tour.step4Content: You are already in the Global League! Score points in real races, watch your balance grow, and compete with other Trixers.
